map.余弦定理和勾股定理关系？: Relation between the law of cosines and Pythagoras?
map.余弦定理是勾股定理的推广：当 C=90° 时 cosC=0，退化为 c²=a²+: The law of cosines generalizes Pythagoras: when C = 90° cosC = 0 and it degenerates to c² = a² + b². The right angle is a special case.
map.什么时候用余弦定理而不是正弦定理？: When use the law of cosines rather than the law of sines?
map.已知两边夹角（求第三边）或已知三边（求角）用余弦定理；已知两角一边或两边及其中一: Use the law of cosines for two sides and the included angle (third side) or three sides (angle); use the law of sines for two angles and one side, or two sides and the opposite angle of one of them.
